style=\"text-align:justify; margin-bottom:11px\"><span style=\"font-size:10pt\"><span style=\"line-height:107%\"><span style=\"word-break:break-all\"><span style=\"font-family:&quot;Malgun Gothic&quot;,sans-serif\"><span lang=\"EN-US\" style=\"font-size:9.0pt\"><span style=\"line-height:107%\"><span style=\"font-family:&quot;微軟正黑體&quot;,sans-serif\">&nbsp; * </span></span></span><span style=\"font-family:&quot;微軟正黑體&quot;,sans-serif\">依各回合地圖的形狀，即使未在所有格子佈置軌道，也能啟用「列車發車」按鈕。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p><p style=\"text-align:justify; margin-bottom:11px\"><span Gothic&quot;,sans-serif\"><span lang=\"EN-US\" style=\"font-size:9.0pt\"><span style=\"line-height:107%\"><span style=\"font-family:&quot;微軟正黑體&quot;,sans-serif\">- </span></span></span><span
